t.name: Prince Creek Trail #1255
t.description: The trail begins at the Prince Creek Campground on the Lake Chelan shoreline and climbs steadily to Horsehead Pass, passing Cub Lake and Boiling Lake along the way.

t.name: North Fork Prince Creek Trail #1254
t.description: The trail provides access from the Prince Creek Trail to the Summit Trail and Surprise and Bernice Lakes.

t.name: Bernice Lake Trail #1259.6
t.description: he Bernice Lake Trail is a rugged, unmaintained backcountry route located in the Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness.

t.name: Surprise Lake Trail #1249
t.description: The 2.4 mile Surprise Lake Trail begins within Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness at Summit Trail 1259 junction and ends at Surprise Lake. Travel through subalpine forest and meadows. The last mile is very steep and equestrian use is not recommended.

t.name: Indianhead Basin Trail #1250
t.description: This historic trail within Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness is not maintained, except for the section from Indianhead Pass to the junction with the Surprise Lake Trail #1249. This maintained section of trail is only accessible from the Surprise Lake Trail

t.name: Box Canyon Trail
t.description: Box Canyon Trail offers views, elevation, lake access, and rustic camping options. The lake can be reached in four miles, the end of the trail in six. Enjoy peaceful vistas and the calming sounds of Lake Chelan.

t.name: Summer Blossom Trail
t.description: The Summer Blossom Trail begins at Grade Creek Road #8200 and ends at Deadman's Pass. The trail is open only to foot traffic and has a few steep grades. This is an excellent trail for viewing Sawtooth high country.

t.name: East Fork Buttermilk Trail
t.description: Thia trail is an easy route up until the last mile to the pass, which is strenuous. This forested hike is cool during the hot summer, with limited views until near Hoodoo Pass and Hoodoo Basin.

t.name: Hoodoo Pass Trail
t.description: The Hoodoo Pass Trail #1259.31 connects Prince Creek drainage (Chelan Ranger District) with the East Fork Buttermilk (Methow Valley Ranger District).

t.name: Libby Creek Trail
t.description: A steep 5.3 mile trail entering the Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness, reaching 7,620 feet elevation, and arriving at the scenic destination of Libby Lake.
